run_changeTexture: run the pybullet script that dynamically changes a texture on a loaded URDF plane in a GUI simulation
loadTexture: load a PNG texture file into pybullet and get a texture unique ID for later use
changeVisualShape: change the rgba color or assign a texture to a visual shape of a loaded URDF body
changeTexture: dynamically update texture pixels at runtime by passing a flat RGB pixel array with width and height
getCameraImage: capture a camera image from the pybullet simulation using the BULLET_HARDWARE_OPENGL renderer
